How transitions are estimated

Four periodic density modes define 25° basin cores. Each frame keeps the last core visited; entry into a different core counts as a passage. Frames before the first core visit are excluded. Runs are analyzed independently.

Lagged probabilities use sliding pairs at 10, 50 or 100 ps, including self transitions and indirect paths through other basins. Counts are correlated; these estimates are not a validated Markov model. A and B interconvert rapidly and need not be separate metastable states.

Lines follow one observed passage per direction, selected near the median passage duration. Display connectors join cores to labeled centers. Chart seam crossings are split. Counts describe gross traffic, not net current. Rare routes retain their observed counts.

The path category has basins as objects and observed route types as generators; morphisms are formal finite paths. The displayed two-step compositions are a finite view of its nerve. It remains distinct from the overlap face-poset nerve.

Data, construction & limits

Three 250 ns ACEMD runs; AMBER ff99SB-ILDN, TIP3P water, 300 K, 1 ps frame spacing. Ten heavy atoms per frame.

Equal-area 12° bins; periodic Gaussian smoothing (σ = 0.85 bins). F/kBT = −log(p/pmax), pooled without reweighting. This is an empirical occupancy landscape, not a validated equilibrium estimate.

The skin is a Gaussian density isosurface of actual conformers selected from bins with ≥25 frames. Each is centered, magnified and translated to (φ, F, ψ). Blending is an artistic embedding, not a solvent-accessible molecular surface or an energy barrier estimate.

The cover uses 18 balls of radius 73° in the cut angular chart. Common membership is witnessed every tenth frame. The displayed category is the face poset of its 2-skeleton; objects, strict inclusions and composition triangles form its nondegenerate nerve. Identities and degenerate simplices are implicit.

Opposite chart edges are physically identified, but the cover overlay does not glue them. No good-cover or homotopy-recovery claim is made. This overlap nerve does not yet encode directed transition pathways.
